scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,worker,beat -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter client dev" "pnpm dev:server" "pnpm worker:server" "pnpm beat:server"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.worker:server: cd server && FORKED_BY_MULTIPROCESSING=1 uv run watchfiles --filter python 'celery -A app.workers.celery_app:celery_app worker -Q general --concurrency=2 --loglevel=INFO' app
scripts.worker:ocr: cd server && FORKED_BY_MULTIPROCESSING=1 OCR_PRECARGAR=true PADDLE_PDX_DISABLE_MODEL_SOURCE_CHECK=True uv run --group ocr celery -A app.workers.celery_app:celery_app worker -Q ocr --concurrency=1 --loglevel=INFO
scripts.beat:server: cd server && uv run celery -A app.workers.celery_app:celery_app beat --schedule=celerybeat-schedule --loglevel=INFO
scripts.init:gerente: cd server && uv run python -m app.comandos.inicializar_gerente
scripts.lint:client: pnpm --filter client exec eslint . --max-warnings 0 && pnpm --filter client exec prettier --check src && pnpm --filter client run type-check
scripts.lint:server: cd server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
